I answered Tobias in the #central-random thread. The ticket for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026, with the import file attached to that ticket. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see it himself. I also passed on Hollis's warning from then: the file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, so that needs sorting out before anyone reimports or they'll create duplicates.
